english: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
text: took ten years to complete 用雕像作话题，说明完成这件作品所需的时间，并不是雕像自己施工。谈项目耗时可说 The project took ten years to complete；若要突出参与者，则可说 They spent ten years on it。
